subject_id.description: A unique numerical identifier assigned to each individual subject in the study.

sex.description: The biological sex of the subject.

age.description: The age of the subject in years.
age.notes: Age at the time of the study/diagnosis.

is_smoke.description: Indicates if the subject is a current smoker.

ever_had_active_tb.description: Indicates if the subject has a prior history of active tuberculosis before the current observation period.

is_hiv_positive.description: Indicates if the subject is positive for the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV).

has_diabetes.description: Indicates if the subject has a diagnosis of diabetes.

tb_status.description: The current tuberculosis diagnosis status of the subject.
tb_status.notes: Values: 'Active TB', 'LTBI' (Latent TB Infection), or 'TB Negative'.

tb_site.description: The anatomical location of the TB infection.
tb_site.notes: Values: 'Pulmonary', 'Extrapulmonary', or 'N/A' if tb_status is not 'Active TB'.

treatment_adherence.description: The subject's adherence level to the prescribed TB treatment regimen.
treatment_adherence.notes: Values may include 'Good', 'Moderate', 'Poor', or 'N/A' if no treatment was administered.

relapsed.description: Binary outcome indicating if the subject experienced a TB relapse after treatment completion.
relapsed.notes: Values: 'Yes', 'No', or 'N/A' if the subject was not treated for Active TB.

event_relapse.description: The event indicator for survival analysis. $1.0$ indicates a relapse event, $0.0$ indicates the subject was censored (no relapse observed) at the time of follow-up.
event_relapse.notes: Relevant primarily for subjects who completed treatment for Active TB.

time_to_relapse.description: The duration, in months, from treatment completion to either the date of relapse or the end of the follow-up period (censoring).
time_to_relapse.notes: Time variable for survival analysis. Relevant primarily for subjects who completed treatment for Active TB.
